description_en: Deletes a specified agent session. This API operation is available only when the canary release feature is enabled. Before calling this operation, ensure that the canary release feature is enabled for the current account and the target region
description_zh: 删除指定 Agent 会话。本接口需要开启灰度才可以使用。调用前请确认当前账号及目标地域已开启相应灰度
name: DeleteAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC protocol version. Set this parameter to 2.0 when you call the operation
parameters.help_zh: JSON-RPC 协议版本，调用时填写 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The correlation identifier for the JSON-RPC request generated by the caller. The identifier is returned as-is in the response. This field is not an idempotency token
parameters.help_zh: 调用方生成的本次 JSON-RPC 请求关联标识，响应原样返回；该字段不是幂等令牌
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The ID of the target session. Use the SessionId returned by CreateAgentSession or obtained from ListAgentSessions
fields.help_zh: 目标会话 ID，使用 CreateAgentSession 返回的 SessionId，或从 ListAgentSessions 查询获得
fields.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The session operation parameters. Serialize the parameters as a JSON object and submit them as a form field. The parameters must include SessionId
parameters.help_zh: 会话操作参数。以 JSON 对象序列化后作为表单字段提交，必须包含 SessionId
parameters.name: params
